title: Derived scene: a base scene plus placed instances of library assets
description: Validated by scripts/assets/asset_lib.py. The derived USD layer (output) is generated from this file by scripts/assets/compose_scene.py and only sublayers base_scene; it never edits it. Paths are relative to the waste-sorting-workstation root.

surface.description: tabletop / floor: lowest collider point at the surface (+ objects.clearance for dynamic bodies; same rule as build_scene.py). on_instance: on the support instance's 'inner_floor'/'top' surface. attached: visual-only asset fixed to a mount point of the support instance (no xy).

xy.description: world xy of the asset origin (all surfaces except attached)

yaw_deg.description: rotation about world Z (attached: about the mount normal frame)

support.description: on_instance / attached: name of an earlier instance

support_surface.description: on_instance (default inner_floor for open_container, top otherwise)

mount.description: attached: mount point of the support asset, e.g. label_+x

pose.description: upright (default): asset Z = world Z. lying: asset axis horizontal, spun by spin_deg about its own axis, then tilted onto the lower convex hull of its colliders under the centre of mass (stable rest pose)

spin_deg.description: lying: rotation about the asset's own axis before lying down

static.description: instance-level override: physics:rigidBodyEnabled = false on this instance only

preview_cameras.description: named preview cameras -> /World/Cameras/<CamelName>; render with render_previews.py --cameras <name> (names must not collide with the base scene's cameras)

deactivate_base_prims.description: base-scene prims made inactive in the derived layer only (active = false; the base file is unchanged). The robot, table, ground, physics scene, lights and cameras cannot be deactivated.

validation.description: scene-level targeted tests run by validate_asset_scene.py

drop_test.description: container instances that get a 6 cm test cube dropped through their open top (session layer only; the scene file is not changed). They must be empty.

move_test.description: dynamic instance teleported (+5 cm, +45 deg yaw) after the settle test: it must resettle on its own; all others must stay put

distinct_assets.description: asset pairs that must be genuinely different geometry (mesh hash, size, volume, section layout)

rigid_bodies_on.description: support instance -> expected number of individual dynamic rigid bodies resting on it
